name: What factors influence the cost of a garage conversion?

mainEntity.name: What factors influence the cost of a garage conversion?

acceptedAnswer.text: Costs vary widely based on square footage, intended use, and plumbing needs. A simple conversion into a dry living area—such as an office or playroom—requires basic framing, insulation, drywall, flooring, and electrical. A full accessory dwelling unit or master suite featuring a bathroom and kitchenette requires underground trenching through the concrete slab, dedicated water and sewer lines, and extensive sub-trade work, which significantly raises costs. HH Remodeling LLC works directly with homeowners to outline clear trade scopes so you know how specific finish choices and layout designs affect your budget.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs depend on room size, insulation needs, and whether you add plumbing for a bathroom or kitchenette, which requires concrete cutting and sub-trade work.
